tacticalIdentity: Network architect. Places Crystal Node, Crystal Prism, and Crystal Wall constructs that store energy, redirect beams, and block movement. Energy Release repeats any stored spell at 70% power from the Node's position. Synergizes with the entire allied roster — any elemental spell fired into a Node becomes a second AoE strike.
designNotes: Max 3 total constructs active. 4th placement collapses oldest existing construct (10 AoE shrapnel damage in 1-tile radius). Each construct type has 15-20 HP.

baseSpells.description: A crystal projectile dealing 5 physical damage at 1 AP. Bounces off Crystal Prisms in its path at 90 degrees toward the nearest valid target, allowing LoS-bypass attacks once the network is established.
baseSpells.designNotes: 1 AP filler. Primary value is Prism bounce for indirect targeting once network is established.

baseSpells.description: Places one crystal construct on a target tile. Crystal Node (2 AP, 1-turn cd): stores the element of the last elemental spell to hit it. Crystal Prism (2 AP, 1-turn cd): redirects beam/line spells at 90 degrees. Crystal Wall (3 AP, 2-turn cd): 3-tile impassable line that sonic spells amplify through. Max 3 constructs simultaneously.
baseSpells.designNotes: Defining action. Every activation that begins with fewer than 3 active constructs should evaluate whether to place. AP costs are low to allow place-then-act in the same activation.

baseSpells.description: Triggers a charged Crystal Node within range 5. The Node releases its stored element as a 2-tile AoE burst at 70% of the stored spell's base damage, with element-appropriate terrain interactions. Node is consumed on release.
baseSpells.designNotes: Primary value proposition. 3 AP repeats ally's most powerful spell at 70% power as a 2-tile AoE. Pillar of Flame stored = 28 AoE damage on release.

baseSpells.description: Crystal energy cascades through the Crystalomancer's construct network. Starting at a targeted construct, energy propagates to all other constructs within 3 tiles of each prior construct. Each construct pulses a 1-tile AoE: 20 damage at the first, 15 at each subsequent. All participating constructs gain +10 temporary HP.
baseSpells.designNotes: Network payoff. With 3 active constructs: 20+15+15 = 50 distributed AoE damage across 3 locations + construct repair. Poor with 1 construct, excellent with 3.

baseSpells.description: Grows a prismatic crystal lattice around an ally that absorbs incoming damage and stores it as coherent light energy. Each hit the ally takes increases PRISMATIC CHARGE counter by 1 (max 3). Crystalomancer may release the charge as a free action: fires a light beam dealing 2×CHARGE damage, applying CHARGED to target. Shell decays unused after 2 turns without damage. Duration: up to 4 turns.
baseSpells.designNotes: Augmentation spell. Reactive damage conversion. Decay mechanic prevents turtling. Max release (6 damage) applies CHARGED to target for Electromancer chain-stun follow-up.
